title: Spencer Chang: a personal site that feels like a lived-in room
note: Left sidebar with a little pixel 'window', the name, a coloured nav (welcome, describe, collaborate, create, write) and a 'Now & Upcoming' list. In the middle, a warm letter-like intro in a serif with tiny inline icons, a yellow 'NOW' sticky note (updated date) and a live status widget. On the right, a 2-column masonry of projects in glowing orange frames with small type tags (project, talks & teaching). Paper texture background, visitor count, webring in the footer. Worth reusing: small human details (Now note, updated date, visitor count) make it feel lived in. Too busy to copy whole.
